intended_behavior: Refine the commit_system prompt to more explicitly instruct the language model to produce ONLY the commit message line without any introductory or trailing text, ensuring no extra unuseful first lines appear in the output. This should preserve the requirement for imperative tense, structured commit message, and one-line limit.

Enhance post-processing to detect and remove any unuseful prefixed or leading lines in the generated commit message before returning it, ensuring the final commit message is clean and starts immediately with the commit description. This complements prompt refinement and preserves the core commit message generation flow.
